name: set_timer
description: Set a timer for the specified duration or end time.

time_human.description: The duration or target end time in human readable format e.g. '1 hour and 30 minutes', '45 minutes', 'for 1:50pm', 'at 13:30'.

name: set_alarm
description: Set an alarm for a specified time.

time_hours.description: The hour component of the alarm time (24 hour time).

time_minutes.description: The minute component of the alarm time (0-59).

label.description: An optional label or title for the alarm.

name: create_reminder
description: Create a reminder for the user at a specific time.

message.description: The reminder message e.g. 'Buy more milk'.

date_time_human.description: The date and/or time for the reminder in human readable format e.g. 'tomorrow at 13:00', 'next Monday at 9am'.

name: create_calendar_event
description: Create a new calendar event with a title, start time, and optional end time.

title.description: The title of the calendar event.

start_time_human.description: The start date/time in human readable format e.g. 'tomorrow at 2pm', 'March 15 at 10:00'.

end_time_human.description: The end date/time in human readable format.

name: snooze_alarm
description: Snooze the currently ringing alarm for a specified duration.

label.description: Label of the alarm to delete.

time_hours.description: Hour of the alarm to delete.

name: get_next_alarm
description: Get the time of the next scheduled alarm.

name: delete_reminder
description: Delete a reminder by matching its message.

search_text.description: Text to match the reminder to delete.

name: get_upcoming_events
description: Get upcoming calendar events for today or a specified date.

date_human.description: Date in human readable format e.g. 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next Friday'. Defaults to today.

name: delete_calendar_event
description: Delete a calendar event by title.

title.description: Title of the event to delete.

name: stop_stopwatch
description: Stop the running stopwatch and return elapsed time.

name: get_current_time
description: Get the current date and time.

name: start_focus_mode
description: Start a focus/concentration session blocking notifications.

duration_minutes.description: Duration of focus session in minutes.

allow_calls.description: Whether to allow phone calls during focus.
